title: Application verdict of one proxied HTTP request
description: The enterprise App-ID verdict of go/detector AppClassifier (PRO-492): the catalog application of the server name and, when a child-app rule of the content data matched, the child application per function with its container. A rule only refines the catalog's identity. limit names a work ceiling that was hit (never silent); a verdict with a limit names no child, and its child_status is undetermined when a child rule could apply. No path, content type, body or credential is recorded; app, container and rule are content-data names.

app.description: The child application when a child rule matched, else the catalog application of the server name, else empty

container.description: The parent of app when app is a child application, else empty

host_owner.description: The catalog application that owns the server name (the identity a child refines); equals app when no child matched, empty when the server name names none. A policy entry for it covers every child matched on its hosts

rule.description: <child>#<rule index> of the matched rule, else empty

child_status.description: Whether the function was decided. undetermined is fail closed: a child rule of the host could apply but the request was refused (not canonical), capped (a field or work ceiling) or ambiguous (a repeated query parameter, a malformed content type, a trailing slash), so app is the parent and the child is unknown; a policy that denies a child denies undetermined for its container too
